---
description: Add, remove or re-port a self-hosted service and keep every repeated fact in sync.
---

Read [root guidance](../../AGENTS.md) and [homelab-service-change](../../.agents/skills/homelab-service-change/SKILL.md). Use [Homelab Operator](../agents/homelab-operator.agent.md) as role guidance.

Task inputs: the service, its port and domain, always-on or on-demand, and the change.
Edit repository copies, regenerate generated files, and run the consistency check and tests. List the outside-Git steps with exact commands and who runs them; do not apply them without approval.
